label: caiso 73 firm shape
definition: (PROBE) caiso-73: measured shaped firm import base — caiso-72 recipe + caiso_firm_import_shape=True single delta (firm blocks' hourly pmax = year DMM RA-import x MIC-split level x unit-mean per-(month x hod) median of measured CISO corridor net imports), 2023-2025. HEADLINE: C7 D-1 diurnal shape flips FAIL->PASS (CT profile_r 0.782/0.771 -> 0.817/0.819 vs 0.8 gate, 2023/24); 2024 CC_REGULAR +9.0 -> +7.64 TWh (C1), 2025 gas +8.5% -> +6.5% (C2); deep-evening (h19-22) 2024 imports 3,341 -> 3,930 MW toward measured 4.9-5.6 GW; midday h14 over-import down. Disclosed risks realized as predicted: 2024 CT 1.23 -> 1.13 TWh (evening imports displace CT — battery/commitment channel attribution), 2023 shifts domestic (firm level drops to its own DMM 2,323 MW; CC +0.9 TWh, tail 473->480 h). C6 governance PASS (zero new free parameters) + C8 PASS. See FINDING-caiso73-firm-import-shape-2026-07-10.
market_story: The firm base is contract structure, not spot economics: CAISO's RA-import and self-scheduled blocks flow on their contracted schedule — heavy overnight and through the evening ramp, thin midday when CAISO's own solar displaces them — so shaping the block's availability by the measured revealed schedule (level still the published DMM RA x MIC sizing) lets evening imports land at their real level and the midday over-import fall, without a price adder or a pinned flow.
